Bash(/Applications/XAMPP/xamppfiles/bin/mysql -u root rsl_system << 'EOF'
-- Portfolio-Wert-Historie \(für Performance-Chart\)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS portfolio_snapshots \(
    id            INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    snapshot_date DATE           NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    total_value   DECIMAL\(15,4\)  NOT NULL COMMENT 'Summe aller offenen Positionen \(aktueller Kurs\)',
    total_invested DECIMAL\(15,4\) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Summe aller Investitionen \(Kaufkurs * Stück\)',
    unrealized_pnl DECIMAL\(15,4\) NOT NULL,
    realized_pnl  DECIMAL\(15,4\)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    sp500_indexed DECIMAL\(15,4\)  COMMENT 'S&P 500 auf Startkapital indiziert',
    created_at    TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
\) ENGINE=InnoDB;

-- Rebalancing-Log \(wann wurde welcher Rebalancing-Hinweis angezeigt\)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rebalancing_log \(
    id            INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    signal_date   DATE        NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    actions       TEXT        COMMENT 'JSON: [{action, ticker, reason}]',
    acknowledged  TINYINT\(1\)  DEFAULT 0,
    created_at    TIMESTAMP   DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
\) ENGINE=InnoDB;

SELECT 'Tabellen angelegt' as status;
EOF)

       MIN\(r.ranking_date\) as first_week, MAX\(r.ranking_date\) as last_week,

ORDER BY times_selected DESC, weeks DESC
